issues.jp_before: 仕事[しごと]を五時[ごじ]までに{終[お]えます|tr-hajimaru}。
issues.problem: 終わる is used transitively by native speakers (仕事を終わります, 授業を終わります), so the distractor 終わります is acceptable with the same meaning.
issues.action: Deleted; replaced with a tr-hajimaru item on intransitive 続く: 会議[かいぎ]が二時間[にじかん]も{続[つづ]きました|tr-hajimaru}。

issues.jp_before: 図書館[としょかん]のドアは五時[ごじ]に自動[じどう]で{閉[し]まります|tr-aku}。
issues.problem: With topic は the door can be read as a topicalised object, so the distractor 閉めます ('we close the door at five') is grammatical. This clinic depends on reading the particle.
issues.action: Changed ドアは to ドアが so only intransitive 閉まる fits; the why now mentions が.

issues.jp_before: この学校[がっこう]では、外国[がいこく]から来[き]た学生[がくせい]が{増[ふ]えています|tr-okiru}。
issues.problem: The English 'students from abroad are increasing' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'At this school, the number of students from abroad is increasing.'
